alt: Handwritten definition: a regular expression is a pattern used to match and replace text. Uses of regular expressions: clean the text, find words, numbers, emails and dates, and remove unwanted symbols.
author: NLP faculty

alt: Handwritten notes on two jobs of regular expressions. Tokenization: splitting sentences into words or tokens, for example NLP is fun becomes NLP, is, fun. Text cleaning: removing unwanted characters like punctuation, html tags and hashtags, for example NLP@2026 is easy becomes NLP2026 is easy.
author: NLP faculty

alt: Handwritten notes on pattern matching: finding similar patterns, shapes and rules inside the text. Example: in my age is 20 and her age is 18 the pattern is the word age followed by a number.
author: NLP faculty

alt: Handwritten notes on information extraction (finding useful information from a large amount of data, for example Google search) and on morphological analysis (breaking a word into smaller meaningful parts, for example Playing is play plus ing, where play is the stem).
author: NLP faculty

alt: Handwritten definition: data preprocessing is cleaning a text before giving it to computers. Example: Hello bbbb, we all love NL@P becomes a cleaned sentence ending in NLP.
author: NLP faculty
